title: Deleting a category still moves its parts and removes its QuickBooks mapping
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Use the staging site with the QuickBooks sandbox connected (and the Tiered Pricing QA site too if QuickBooks is connected there); production is not needed.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, mapped to a QuickBooks Products and Services item, with a part in the inventory, part A.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Categories.
  2. Click category A's row.
  3. Open the page's three-dot menu.
  4. Click Delete.
  5. Click Delete in the dialog.
  6. Open part A in the inventory.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Category A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Category A's page shows its QuickBooks item.

Step 3:

  • The menu lists Delete.

Step 4:

  • The delete question opens.

Step 5:

  • Category A is deleted and no longer listed.
  • The Categories page still lists Uncategorized first.

Step 6:

  • Part A's category reads Uncategorized.
